The '''roaamin''' was a biological substance produced in the body of a [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]], in the anterior lobes of the [[lutiaary gland]]. Through a chain of consequences, low [[theloxin]] levels in a Pau'an could affect the production of roaamin, which might result in [[giantism]].
